title.en: tailgate flea market at kista galleria.

line.en: a large tailgate flea market at kista galleria on sunday from late morning. bring a bag and some cash.
line.de: ein großer kofferraum-flohmarkt in der kista galleria am sonntag ab dem vormittag. tasche und etwas bargeld mitnehmen.
line.tr: pazar günü öğleden önce kista galleria'da büyük bir bagaj pazarı. bir çanta ve biraz nakit al.

sparks.why: Gratis i Stockholm lists a big bakluckeloppis at Kista Galleria on 22 Nov, and Stockholmsmarknader's calendar agrees; the 11:00 start is from the calendar and may change.
